$comment: Derived artifact. The legacy rule table, rebuilt from the authored spreadsheet.

rows from 2, blank rows skipped, rows missing topic/category/hukum not inserted.

that map predicts. Ids 173 and 174 are absent here: they have no spreadsheet row.
start_from and notes are the editorial columns. Neither engine reads them; they are
kept because they are evidence. See docs/questions/ for the open question on them.
